name: review-loop
description: Actor-Critic review->fix->re-review loop with focused per-round tests, one final full validation, adversarial verification, and bounded convergence

scope.description: git range / PR# / file; default = current branch vs merge-base
scope.default: the current branch vs its merge-base with main, else staged, else HEAD

reviewers.description: adversarial verifiers per finding; clamped to 1-3

threshold.description: survive if at least this share vote real; clamped to 0-1

chunkTargetLines.description: target diff lines per critic lane; clamped to 1-10000

maxFindingsPerLane.description: highest-priority actionable findings per critic lane; clamped to 1-10

maxVerifyClaimsPerRound.description: deduplicated findings verified per round; clamped to 1-16 and overflow is retained

focusedTestMaxCommands.description: maximum narrow validation commands per fix round; clamped to 1-5

fixerTimeoutMs.description: fixer timeout in milliseconds; clamped to 60000-1800000

focusedValidationTimeoutMs.description: focused validator timeout in milliseconds; clamped to 60000-1800000

finalValidationTimeoutMs.description: final full validator timeout in milliseconds; clamped to 300000-3600000
